Question: Is it correct to kiss Quran before starting reading Quran or completion of reciting Quran? Answer ID: 15807 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1398/1405=L=1430) Yes, it is alright. کما ھو ثابت بفعل عمر وعثمان رضي اللہ عنھما وکفی بنا قدوۃ (الشامي 9:552) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
